key_facts: JustLock unlock is permissionless but requires possession of the LockReceipt NFT; used receipts are locked in an unwithdrawable vault; receipt resmgr mint/update roles are DenyAll (no forgery, no owner override)
JustLock forever locks (unlockable_at=None) are provably stuck for EVERYONE (panic reproduced in preview; no replacement receipt possible)
RlyFun claim_fee moves the entire 633,433 XRD EarlyPump fee vault to the holder of the pump owner badge (P); a self-minted dev badge is rejected by an explicit resource check
RlyFun curve reserves cannot be drained with foreign tokens (vault-level DropAccess protection) and round-trips are fee-negative

RadLock live system is the v2 proxy/logic deployment (NOT the package in the brief); all value paths are badge-role gated: admin badge (supply 1, dApp account), storage_access_auth (supply 4, components only), component_auth (component badge)
RadLock user withdrawals require two owned proofs (receipt NFT + user badge); ~$115.6k nominal sits in user locks recoverable only by their holders after unlock time
Public gateway stream filter field is affected_global_entities_filter (not filter); package addresses only register on publish/upgrade transactions
